title: Run agent (prompt)
text: Trim the native input and lock immediately.
explanation: The provider is mounted above Expo Router screens, so navigation preserves the lab. Server validation repeats these constraints.

title: POST /api/agent/stream
explanation: The public base URL changes for web, emulator and physical devices. The Claude key never enters the Expo dependency graph.

title: Validate; tools disabled
text: Validate untrusted JSON on the server.
explanation: The HTTP adapter enforces explicit CORS and a 32 KiB body limit before handlers validate content type and a trimmed 1–4000 character prompt.

title: streamAgent() / query()
text: Route the request to the Node SDK service.
explanation: A separate Node process can run the CLI-backed Agent SDK while the Expo client remains native. This server boundary is the same for web and devices.

title: Prompt; no built-in tools
text: Invoke the actual TypeScript Agent SDK.
explanation: The SDK owns the Claude transport and CLI runtime. This source is the application call boundary, not an implementation of the SDK’s internal network request.

title: Model response
explanation: The SDK returns model and lifecycle messages to this application loop. Tools, skills, MCP, plugins and sessions are disabled through explicit options.

title: Safe SDK message
text: Project SDK messages into public contracts.
explanation: Only selected text, system subtype and final result fields leave the server. Exact API-key occurrences are redacted before summary truncation.

title: SSE message event
explanation: Heartbeats, request cancellation, reader cancellation and the three-minute deadline clean up stream execution.

title: Update typed state
text: Append a timestamped native timeline row.
explanation: The display stops at 500 rows, while every final result is still processed independently. Each row can expand to syntax-colored JSON.

title: ResultMessage fields
explanation: Non-success subtypes remain failures. Answer, turns, duration, cost and error flag are the complete public result.
code:
function resultData(message: SDKResultMessage): AgentResult {
  return {
    result:
      message.subtype === "success"
        ? redact(message.result || "")
        : "The agent could not complete this prompt. Check the server configuration.",
    num_turns: message.num_turns,
    duration_ms: message.duration_ms,
    total_cost_usd: message.total_cost_usd ?? null,
    is_error: message.subtype !== "success" || Boolean(message.is_error),

title: SSE ResultMessage
text: Validate a ResultMessage received over SSE.
explanation: The final result uses the same message event as progress. Missing final results and prematurely closed transports fail explicitly.

title: Render answer + metrics
text: Render the answer as native text and colored code.
explanation: There is no raw HTML insertion or WebView. Markdown headings, bold text, safe HTTP(S) links and code fences map to native components; other markup remains text.

title: SSE done event
text: Require both final result and done.
explanation: Completion cannot override the final is_error flag. The incremental parser handles split Unicode, CRLF, comments and multiple frames.

title: SSE error; no done
text: Emit a safe SSE error without done.
explanation: Simple-mode provider failures return 502. Raw exceptions, filesystem paths and environment values are not sent to clients.

title: Error + snackbar
text: Show an error and accessible notice.
explanation: Controls restore in finally. Native cancellation, disconnects and the client deadline abort owned work.

title: Key: SSE error / input: 422
text: Reject missing credentials before calling the SDK.
explanation: Simple mode returns 503. Invalid inputs return validation status before streaming starts. Neither path makes a paid model call.
